description: Certificate of lawfulness for proposed change of use of dwelling from C3 (single residential dwellinghouse) to C2 (residential institution) for up to 2 residents and carers.
decision_conditions: The Local Planning Authority considers that insufficient and inconsistent information has been submitted regarding the nature and operation of the proposed use. The application documents variously describe the proposal as a residential care home, supported living accommodation and accommodation for persons aged between 16 and 75 years. In the absence of a clear and definitive description of the proposed use and intended occupiers, the Council is unable to adequately assess the planning impacts of the development and it is considered difficult to conclude whether the proposed use would fall within Use Class C2.
